# velora-compressor

Archive Manager is a fast and lightweight application for creating and extracting archives.

- Repository: <https://github.com/LingmoOS/velora-compressor>
- License: `GPL-3.0-or-later`
- One-line summary source: `debian/control` (`Description` of `Package: deepin-compressor`)

## Build

The top-level build script is `CMakeLists.txt` at the repository root (`cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.9.5)`).

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
sudo cmake --install build
```
